sections: Family Lawyers in Lahore: Which Family Court Hears Your Case
Choose The Court By Residence, Not Convenience

Lahore district has family courts at the district headquarters and in its tehsils, including Model Town, Cantonment, Raiwind and Shalimar. Under rule 6 of the West Pakistan Family Courts Rules, 1965, a suit is filed where the cause of action arose or where the parties reside or last resided together, and suits for dissolution, dower and maintenance may also be filed where the wife ordinarily resides. A wife who has returned to her parents in Samanabad can usually file there even if the couple lived in DHA. Our family lawyers in Lahore check the addresses on the Nikah Nama, the CNICs and any earlier notices before drafting.
Family Lawyers in Lahore for Talaq Notice and the Union Council
Section 7 Notice, Ninety Days And The Certificate

A husband who pronounces talaq must give written notice to the Chairman of the union council where the wife resides, with a copy to her, under section 7 of the Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961. The talaq takes effect ninety days after the notice is delivered, or at the end of pregnancy if later. Lahore includes the Lahore and Walton cantonments, where the competent local office for family records should be confirmed first. Failing to give notice is an offence. Family lawyers in Lahore prepare the notice, keep proof of delivery and follow the file to the effectiveness certificate that NADRA requires.
Family Lawyers in Lahore for Khula and Dissolution
Reconciliation, Decree And Financial Claims

A wife may seek Khula, or dissolution on the grounds in section 2 of the Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act, 1939, such as failure to maintain for two years, cruelty or desertion. Under section 10 of the Family Courts Act, 1964 the court first attempts reconciliation; if that fails in a Khula suit, it decrees dissolution and may direct the return of benefits received, such as prompt dower. The Act allows claims for dower, maintenance and dowry articles to be joined in the same suit, so we decide at the outset which claims to bring together.
Family Lawyers in Lahore: Punjab Law That Applies
Registration, Second Marriage And Marriage Age

Lahore is the seat of Punjab’s legislature, and Punjab law applies alongside the federal family statutes. The Punjab Muslim Family Laws (Amendment) Act, 2015 strengthened marriage-registration duties and the consequences of a second marriage contracted without the Arbitration Council’s permission under section 6 of the MFLO. The Punjab Child Marriage Restraint Act, 2026 fixes eighteen as the minimum age for both parties, and the Punjab Protection of Women against Violence Act, 2016 provides protection, residence and monetary orders. Family lawyers in Lahore record which provincial rule applies to each claim.
Family Lawyers in Lahore for Child Custody and Visitation
Welfare Of The Child Decides

Custody, visitation and guardianship applications are made under the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 to the guardian judge where the minor ordinarily resides, and section 17 makes the welfare of the minor the paramount consideration. Mothers are ordinarily preferred for the custody of young children, but the court looks at the facts, including remarriage, schooling and who has actually been caring for the child. Interim custody and a visitation schedule can be sought while the case is pending. Our family lawyers in Lahore prepare school, medical and care records and a visitation plan the court can enforce.
Guardianship of a Minor’s Person and Property
Legal Authority Is Different From Day-To-Day Care

A parent who has the child does not automatically have authority to sell the child’s inherited property, consent to every travel step or deal with institutions. A guardian certificate under the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 may be needed, and the court will ask what authority is required and why. Pakistan has no adoption statute; a family that wishes to care for a child who is not its own proceeds through guardianship. We frame the application around the specific authority the child’s welfare requires.
Family Lawyers in Lahore for Wife and Child Maintenance
Interim Orders And Proof Of Income

Section 17A of the Family Courts Act, 1964 allows the court to fix interim maintenance at the first hearing, and failure to pay it can have serious consequences for the defence. The final amount depends on the husband’s means and the needs of the wife and children. Lahore claims often involve salaried employees, traders in the Walled City markets or overseas workers, and the evidence of income differs in each case. Our family lawyers in Lahore help gather salary slips, business and property records, or other evidence of means before the claim is filed.
Dower and Dowry Articles
Read The Nikah Nama; List The Articles

Prompt dower is payable on demand; deferred dower becomes payable on divorce or death, as recorded in the Nikah Nama, and section 10 of the MFLO treats dower as payable on demand where the mode of payment is not specified. Dowry articles and bridal gifts remain the wife’s property and are recovered through the family court. A dated list with receipts, wedding photographs or witnesses who saw the articles delivered is the strongest evidence. A wife should not sign a statement acknowledging full receipt of dower or articles that she has not actually received.
Marriage Records and Lahore Court Marriage
Disputes Are Different From Ceremonies

Many Lahore disputes turn on the Nikah Nama: a blank delegated-divorce clause, a dower entry, or a registration that was never completed. Our family lawyers in Lahore review the record and the union council entry before a claim is drafted. Adult couples who want to marry are a different matter, handled through our Lahore court marriage service, where eligibility, free consent, witnesses and registration are arranged separately.
Family Lawyers in Lahore for Appeals Before the Lahore High Court
Act Quickly After A Decree

Appeals from family-court decrees lie under section 14 of the Family Courts Act, 1964 within the time allowed, and many interim orders are not appealable at all. The Lahore High Court’s principal seat is in Lahore, and constitutional petitions under Article 199 from Lahore family cases are heard there. An appeal does not automatically suspend execution; a stay must be sought where it is needed. Send certified copies of the decree and the record as soon as judgment is given.
Overseas Pakistanis With Lahore Family Cases
Power Of Attorney, Service And Evidence

A spouse living abroad can usually instruct counsel through a special power of attorney executed before a Pakistani mission or notarised and attested, and many stages can proceed without repeated travel. Service on a husband abroad, recognition of a foreign divorce, and a child brought to Lahore by one parent each raise separate questions. Family lawyers in Lahore set out which steps need the client personally and which can proceed through the attorney, and coordinate with our Islamabad, Rawalpindi and Karachi offices where a connected case is pending there.
faqs: What Do Your Family Lawyers In Lahore Handle?

Divorce and talaq notices, Khula and dissolution, custody and visitation, guardianship, wife and child maintenance, dower and dowry articles, and appeals from family-court decisions. We advise, draft and represent before the Lahore family courts and the Lahore High Court.
Where Is Your Lahore Office?
At 2nd Floor, Al-Mairaj Arcade, Near Surayya Azeem Trust Hospital, Chauburji Chowk, Lahore. Call or WhatsApp +92 333 1127835 to book before visiting.
Which Lahore Family Court Should I File In?

The court of the area where the cause of action arose or where the parties live or last lived together. For dissolution, dower and maintenance suits, the court where the wife ordinarily resides also has jurisdiction under rule 6 of the Family Courts Rules, 1965.
Is Talaq The Same Procedure As Khula?
No. Talaq is pronounced by the husband and requires notice to the union council Chairman under section 7 of the MFLO 1961. Khula is a decree of the family court on the wife’s suit.
Where Is A Talaq Notice Sent In Lahore?
To the Chairman of the union council where the wife resides, with a copy to the wife. In cantonment areas, confirm the competent local office first.
How Long Does Khula Take In Lahore?

It depends on service of the husband and the court’s list. Where the husband is served and reconciliation fails, the court can decree Khula at the pre-trial stage; joined financial claims may take longer.
Does Khula End My Claims For Dower And Dowry?
No. Join them to the suit or bring them separately. The court may direct the return of benefits received from the husband, so the financial position should be assessed before filing.
Who Gets Custody Of A Young Child?
The court decides on the welfare of the child under the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890. Mothers are ordinarily preferred for young children, but the facts of each case decide the result.
Can I Get A Visitation Order Quickly?
An interim visitation schedule can be sought while the custody case is pending. A practical proposal with times and a handover place helps the court decide.
Is Guardianship Different From Custody?
Yes. Custody is day-to-day care; guardianship gives legal authority over the child’s person or property. A guardian certificate may be needed for property or institutional steps.
Can Interim Maintenance Be Ordered At The First Hearing?
Yes. Section 17A of the Family Courts Act, 1964 allows the court to fix interim maintenance at the first hearing.
How Do I Prove My Husband’s Income?
Salary slips, bank records, business or property documents, vehicles, lifestyle evidence and witnesses. The court fixes maintenance on the evidence of his means.
Can Unpaid Haq Mehr Be Recovered?
Yes, through the family court. Prompt dower is payable on demand; deferred dower on divorce or death, as recorded in the Nikah Nama.
What If My In-Laws Keep My Dowry Articles?
File for recovery in the family court with a dated list of articles and any receipts, photographs or witnesses.
What If My Husband Married Again Without Permission?
Section 6 of the MFLO 1961 and Punjab’s 2015 amendment apply. The first wife may have civil claims, and a complaint may lie against the husband.
What Is The Marriage Age In Lahore?
Eighteen for both parties under the Punjab Child Marriage Restraint Act, 2026.
I Live Abroad. Can My Lahore Case Proceed?
Usually yes, through a special power of attorney and properly arranged evidence. Some stages may still need you personally.
Where Are Appeals From Lahore Heard?
Appeals lie under section 14 of the Family Courts Act, 1964. Constitutional petitions are heard by the Lahore High Court at its principal seat in Lahore.
How Are Fees Agreed?
Fees depend on the work: advice, drafting, number of hearings and whether an appeal follows. The scope and any court or documentation costs are agreed in writing before work starts.
What Should I Bring To The Chauburji Consultation?
The Nikah Nama, both CNICs, any talaq notice, plaint or order, children’s documents, a dowry list if relevant, and evidence of income or payments.
